distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Hainan, Jiangxi and Yunnan under the current Planiculus bicolor concept. Beaver & Liu (2010), under the source-specific name Planiculus laevis, records Taiwan from Nantou, Hui Son. Under the current integrated taxonomic backbone reconciliation this evidence maps to VSN_4669, so Taiwan is added to the current synthesis while the historical species-boundary treatment remains explicit.

host_note: Species-level host Cyclobalanopsis glauca from Smith et al. (2020) is retained as published. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes Planiculus laevis as polyphagous but enumerates no host taxon in the curated field; no additional host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Planiculus bicolor (Blandford, 1894).
